text_en: O come, let us sing to the Lord ; let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation!
text_cn: 请大家前来，我们要向上主歌舞， 齐向救助我们的磐石高歌欢呼。

text_en: Let us come into his presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to him with songs of praise!
text_cn: 一齐到他面前，感恩赞颂， 向他歌吟圣诗，欢呼吟咏。

text_en: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods.
text_cn: 上主原是尊高的天主， 原是超越诸神的大主；

text_en: In his hand are the depths of the earth; the heights of the mountains are his also.
text_cn: 大地的深渊，全在他手， 高山的顶峰，为他所有。

text_en: The sea is his, for he made it, and the dry land, which his hands have formed.
text_cn: 海洋属他，因为是他创造的， 陆地也是他亲手所形成的。

text_en: O come, let us worship and bow down, let us kneel before the Lord , our Maker!
text_cn: 请大家前来，一齐伏地朝拜， 向造我们的上主，屈膝示爱。

text_en: For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. O that today you would listen to his voice!
text_cn: 因为他是我们的真神， 我们是他牧养的人民， 是他手所引导的羊群。 今天该听从他的声音：

text_en: Do not harden your hearts, as at Meribah, as on the day at Massah in the wilderness,
text_cn: “不要再像在默黎巴那样心顽， 也不要像在旷野中玛撒那天！

text_en: when your ancestors tested me, and put me to the proof, though they had seen my work.
text_cn: 你们的祖先虽然见过我的工作， 在那里他们还是试探我，考验我。

text_en: For forty years I loathed that generation and said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they do not regard my ways. ”
text_cn: 四十年之久，我厌恶了那一世代， 曾说：这百姓心中迷惑，不肯承认我的真道，

text_en: Therefore in my anger I swore, “They shall not enter my rest. ”
text_cn: 因此我怀着愤怒而起誓说： 他们决不得进入我的安所。”
